morgan.k: Heads up — planning to add a partial index on transactions.created_at and run a small sharded backfill tonight. Target window 23:45-00:30 UTC. Need a deploy owner, SRE oncall, and rollback owner. Quick smoke checklist below. @tess @raj @linda

 t ess: I can own deploy, I'm free from 23:15 -> 01:00. I'll run the migration and coordinate with SRE. :white_check_mark:

 raj: I'll be SRE oncall for that window and will keep an eye on p99, CPU, and replica lag. Will set up dashboards and alerts.

 linda: I'll prepare rollback scripts and a pause plan for the backfill. Will do a dry run on staging after the canary.

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for staging at 22:30 UTC. Job: staging-index-canary-1745554321. Link: https://deploys/redwood/canary/1745554321

 morgan.k: Canary plan: apply index on staging with CONCURRENTLY, run 30m synthetic traffic focused on high-read paths. Abort criteria: p99 > 300ms for read endpoints OR replica lag > 5s OR >10% CPU increase sustained for 5m.

 tess: Deploy steps (short):
 1) run CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tx_created_at_partial ON transactions (created_at) WHERE status = 'settled';
 2) start sharded backfill: ./jobs/run_backfill --shard=<n> --batch=5000 --rate-limit=200
 3) monitor dashboards (p99, rds.cpu, replica_lag, slow_queries)
 4) if clean, mark complete in runbook and close slot.

 tess: Commands I'll run on prod (I will paste these into the runbook just before the window):
 ```
 -- create index concurrently
 CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tx_created_at_partial ON transactions (created_at) WHERE status = 'settled';
 -- start backfill (example)
 ./jobs/run_backfill --shard=3 --batch=5000 --rate-limit=200 --dry-run=false
 -- rollback (drop)
 DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tx_created_at_partial;
 ```

 raj: SRE checklist I've prepared:
 - pre-window: snapshot replica lag baseline, confirm binlog slot healthy
 - during: live p99 + per-route traces, replica lag, RDS CPU, slow query sample
 - abort triggers: replica_lag > 8s OR sustained p99 > 350ms OR error rate spike > 1%
 - on abort: coordinate with @tess to stop backfill (./jobs/pause_backfill --all), then run DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY if index already present and causing issues.

 linda: Rollback runbook (short):
 1) set backfill to paused: ./jobs/pause_backfill --id=<backfill-id>
 2) ensure no active writers to index (quiet window)
 3) DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tx_created_at_partial;
 4) resume in next window after postmortem.
 I'll paste exact snippets in the runbook doc.

 morgan.k: Can we tighten to 23:45-00:30 instead of earlier window? Means less global impact. All ok?

 tess: :thumbsup: ok for me at 23:45.

 raj: ok from SRE side. I'll be on pager.

 deploy-bot: Reminder: toggle maintenance page: https://status.redwood/maintenance if you expect user-visible latency.

 morgan.k: Perfect — I'll post the final runbook + checklist 1 hour before the window and pin it. In the meantime I'll drop the canary results in this thread after 22:45. If anyone can't make the window, call it out now.

 tess: All good. I will also add a quick smoke script that hits the top 5 read endpoints and a single write path.

 raj: I'll add an alert playbook to the dashboard and leave my phone on.

 linda: Dry-run on staging now, will report if anything odd.

 morgan.k: Thanks team — see you tonight. :rocket:
